label: Nuclear characterization control, checked
meaning: Premise-free control. The general part takes the unique object characterized by {g, o, existent}. The model's objects are the sets of the nuclear properties god, benevolent and existent, one object per set; the extranuclear-existent objects are the nuclear-existent non-gods. The object {god, benevolent, existent} is a nuclear-existent god that does not exist extranuclearly. Its nuclear definitional frame satisfies 'whatever is defined is true' (every nuclear description is satisfied), but the existing-god description is not nuclear, and no being is a god. With 'in act at esse' read nuclearly, 'more in being' ranking that object above every other and a trivial causal relation, the naming premise's form holds and that object is the unique maximum. The model shows that the restricted principle is consistent, that characterization confers EXISTENCE_5 only, and that the naming premise carries no existential import of its own: on a nuclear reading of being in act at esse, it and the maximum deliver a god object that does not exist. It is a model of one formal interpretation, not evidence that Meinongian object theory is true or that being in act at esse is nuclear.
